# Where vendor/msgpack.js came from, and how to re-vendor it.
#
# The Lab does not build Diluvium and does not depend on npm at runtime, so
# the codec the queue layer speaks is a pinned copy rather than a package.
# It is byte-identical to upstream on purpose: re-vendoring is `cp`, and a
# diff against upstream is meaningful.
#
# The vectors beside it (test/fixtures/msgpack-vectors.json) were generated
# by the C implementation, src/dmsgpack.c -- so test/msgpack.spec.js checks
# cross-implementation agreement rather than one reading of the spec.

repo    https://github.com/Aloecraft-org/diluvium
tag     v5.5.1_build5
commit  4ddd65f65d1507d8e4757de9b5e9df7fe87e4797

vendor/msgpack.js                 <- bindings/js/src/msgpack.js
sha256  9546ea35bd41f9ba974332389bd3ed3e295a0989bb0c81f96dea1c25f49298a8

test/fixtures/msgpack-vectors.json <- bindings/js/test/vectors.json
sha256  0a36e07765543da1ba872b73a5b2c1b3a5977800017e0461b1c2e19bfcd9c617
